name: Salyut
about: Salyut (1971-032A), a station core, launched 1971 Apr 19. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (D).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1971 May 22), held fixed
